decision: Retain the narrowly bounded local indentation correctness fix after investigating the observed task-quality gap; retain the failed registered model gate and make no model efficacy/noninferiority claim.
basis: Six byte/safety cases improve3/6 to6/6; original known whole replacements become stable2→2→2 instead of2→4→6;283 focused regressions passed. The changed route is absent from this paid panel,so this panel neither exercises the fix nor identifies its model effect.
limitations: This investigation does not erase the adverse candidate endpoint or establish population quality equivalence. Do not promote a model optimization from all-attempt token/cost totals; future efficacy needs preselected exposed tasks and preserved unconstrained tool choice.
